profile_text.body:
Equifax describes itself as a credit bureau that provides credit reports and credit scores for businesses and consumers. It also offers identity protection tools with daily monitoring and alerts, and markets Equifax Complete for monitoring credit and protecting identity. The company says dedicated ID Restoration Specialists work on a customer's behalf to help recover from identity theft. Its site also carries educational material on credit reports and scores, debt, credit cards, loans, fraud warning signs, and personal finance, including Spanish-language content on Equifax credit reports in the United States.

The company is a for-profit public company traded under the ticker EFX, with CIK 0000033185, headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.

Litigation exposure is recorded in Georgia, with a count of 91 cases. The site text describes no AI-specific products.
